name: Agent Looper
description: Takes a build task plus a definition of done, then cycles a coding agent on your machine until the stated check passes. Requires a test or condition that can actually be evaluated — vague goals give it nothing to loop against.

official.title: Agent Looper by dancingteeth
official.description: You say what to build and how to know it's done. It keeps a coding agent working on your computer until that check passes.
